faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Prasar Bharati Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Prasar Bharati Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) posts is 15th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Graduation from any UGC-recognised university. Additionally, proficiency in reading, writing, and translating English/Urdu text into the Balti language is essential, along with a good quality voice suitable for broadcasting.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this position is between 21 years and 50 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General and OBC category candidates need to pay Rs. 354, while SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written test followed by a voice test. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a contractual position. This means the selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for a specified period.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official Prasar Bharati website. A direct link to the official website is provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. Candidates applying should be willing to work in this region.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any vacancies announced for this post?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, the total number of vacancies for the Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) post is 0. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates or specific details regarding vacancies.
